description: This file defines a generic, non-thread-safe rate limiter class 'MessageRateLimiter' used for controlling message flow based on in-flight messages, redelivery expectations, and consumption rates within an AMQP messaging context.

classes.name: MessageRateLimiter
classes.description: A generic rate limiter class for controlling message flow, based on message IDs, with configurable limits on per-period consumption and in-flight messages. It is marked as not thread-safe and intended for use within a single actor's thread.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a MessageRateLimiter instance based on Amqp10Config and enabled flag.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the rate limiter is enabled.

methods.name: getConsumedInPeriod
methods.description: Returns the number of messages consumed within the current period.

methods.name: getMaxPerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of messages allowed to be consumed per period.

methods.name: getInFlight
methods.description: Returns the current number of in-flight messages.

methods.name: getToBeRedelivered
methods.description: Returns the number of messages pending redelivery.

methods.name: getMaxInFlight
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of in-flight messages allowed.

methods.name: getRedeliveryExpectationTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration after which redelivery is expected or considered expired.

methods.name: incoming
methods.description: Records the receipt of a new message, updating in-flight and redelivery sets.

methods.name: terminallyAcknowledged
methods.description: Acknowledges a message with no redelivery expected, decreasing in-flight count.

methods.name: redeliveryRequested
methods.description: Marks a message for redelivery, updating in-flight and redelivery sets.

methods.name: forgetPendingRedelivery
methods.description: Removes a message from the pending redelivery set.

methods.name: isConsumerOpen
methods.description: Checks if the consumer is open.

methods.name: isMaxPerPeriodExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the consumption limit per period has been exceeded.

methods.name: isMaxInFlightExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the in-flight or redelivery pending limit has been exceeded.

methods.name: reduceConsumedInPeriod
methods.description: Periodically called to reduce the consumption counter, simulating time passing.
